headline: Stonecradle and Expanse Erupt as Mercy Holds
war_summary: Since the last edition Stonecradle has seized the wire with five changes in two hours and sixteen on the day about The Reach, World's End, The Dais and The Heir's Knife, last at 15:15, amid 6,905 Colonial and 9,088 Warden casualties on the day. The Weathered Expanse has reawakened with three in two hours and nineteen on the day about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, last at 13:57, standing five Warden to four Colonial with 1,295 Colonial and 1,469 Warden losses in two hours still accelerating. Linn Mercy remains active with two in two hours and sixteen on the day about Lathair and Rotdust, last at 13:45, holding ten Colonial with one in no-man's-land. Stlican Shelf shows two in two hours and nine on the day about Thornhold and Fort Hoarfrost, last at 14:58, standing five Warden to four Colonial. Dead Lands and Mooring County have gone quiet with none in two hours after five and eight on the day respectively, while Callahan's Passage reports heavy losses with no flips.
